name: Authority Over Your Children
overview: Scripture establishes the God-ordained authority of parents over their children, emphasizing the importance of teaching and discipline rooted in love and reverence for God. Parents are commanded to instruct their children diligently in daily life, as seen in Deuteronomy 11:19, and to exercise firm correction, including the use of the rod, to guide them away from folly and destruction (Proverbs 13:24; 19:18; 22:15). Honoring parents is not only a moral duty but also a command that carries the promise of long life (Exodus 20:12), while disrespect toward parents is met with severe consequences (Exodus 21:15), underscoring the seriousness of maintaining proper family order under God’s authority.
